data.description: Upgraded | Corner Unit | Close To Lake and Park
data.long_description:
Immaculate and very well upgraded corner villa with huge landscaped garden available for rent in Springs 9.

Discover serene family living in one of Dubai’s most sought-after gated communities—Springs 9, nestled within Emirates Living and offering lakeside charm, lush greenery, and premium amenities

Villa features:-

- Type 4E  (2 bedrooms + study room)
- Corner unit
- 3 en-suite bathrooms 
- Walking distance to lake
- Immaculate garden
- BUA: 1,800 sq.ft
- Plot: 2,512 sq.ft
- Large living room
- Separate new Ikea Kitchen fully equipped
- Dining or study
- Bagnodesign Powder room
- Laundry room
- 2 en-suite bedrooms with redesigned Bathrooms, Bagno design signature
- New LG A/C
- 2 Balconies
- Fully landscaped and mature garden
- Parking for 2 cars
-24/7 gated community
Can be rented fully furnished as well for 195,000 AED.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
